BiblicalUsage: Patsam means to rend, to split by an earthquake. It appears once, in Psalm 60:2, where the psalmist says, Thou hast made the earth to tremble; Thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof, for it shaketh.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the broken earth in this psalm is prayed over, not just lamented, and the same God who shook it is asked to heal the breach.
